subject: maths
question:
The bar graph shows the number of cars and the number of total vehicles in thousands, registered in given months. What was the total number of vehicles other than cars registered in the given months?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ed9d1b8f2a7a253f3220104601d2ba4b34ece817178b4ce70f7d9abe4a66da6.png]
solution:
**Formula Used:**

Number of other vehicles = Total number of vehicles - Number of cars

Total number of other vehicles = Sum of (Total vehicles - Cars) for each month

**Calculation:**

The number of vehicles other than cars:

January: Other vehicles = 27 - 21 = 6 (in thousands)

March: Other vehicles = 22 - 15 = 7 (in thousands)

May: Other vehicles = 25 - 15 = 10 (in thousands)

June: Other vehicles = 36 - 20 = 16 (in thousands)

August: Other vehicles = 40 - 24 = 16 (in thousands)

Total number of other vehicles = 6 + 7 + 10 + 16 + 16 = 55 (in thousands)

**∴ The total number of vehicles other than cars registered in the given months was 55,000. **
